meta.description: Registry for selection-related failure modes including forced uniqueness, unresolved degeneracy, and selection oscillation.

failure_modes.name: forced_unique_continuation_error
failure_modes.description: System incorrectly assumes a unique continuation when multiple admissible paths exist.

failure_modes.name: unresolved_degenerate_minimum
failure_modes.description: Selection logic fails to handle multiple candidates with equal metric values.

failure_modes.name: tie_resolution_ambiguity
failure_modes.description: Multiple tie-breaking rules conflict or produce inconsistent selections.

failure_modes.name: selection_oscillation
failure_modes.description: Selection logic results in periodic switching between disparate states or regimes.

failure_modes.name: selection_aliasing
failure_modes.description: Distinct process states map to identical selection metrics, creating unresolvable ambiguity.

failure_modes.name: branch_width_overflow
failure_modes.description: Retained branch set exceeds formal bounds due to insufficient pruning or selection constraints.

failure_modes.name: equivalence_overcollapse
failure_modes.description: Merging non-equivalent candidates during selection results in information loss.

failure_modes.name: equivalence_undercollapse
failure_modes.description: Failure to merge equivalent branches leads to redundant processing or non-convergence.

failure_modes.name: nonunique_reconstruction
failure_modes.description: Reconstruction from observed continuation fails to identify a unique preimage or equivalence class.

failure_modes.name: selection_reconstruction_failure
failure_modes.description: Observed continuation events lack sufficient evidence to reconstruct the original selection rule application.

failure_modes.name: stochastic_selection_overclaim
failure_modes.description: Probabilistic selection models are treated as formal evidence for unique continuation.
